critic.reason: The cited contract header, commercial rebrand note, and registry row jointly establish that MSA-OAK-2018's counterparty Oakfield Logistics GmbH and billing referent Oakfield Logistik GmbH are the same legal entity via unchanged registration number HRB 88421.
